أنتقض (form VIII)
# أَنْتَقِضُ (ʔantaqiḍu) /ʔan.ta.qi.dˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَضَ (intaqaḍa)
# أَنْتَقِضَ (ʔantaqiḍa) /ʔan.ta.qi.dˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَقَضَ (intaqaḍa)
# أَنْتَقِضْ (ʔantaqiḍ) /ʔan.ta.qidˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْتَقَضَ (intaqaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
